constructor.details: Reverts if any of the arguments is zero

params.decisionTimeout: The time window (in seconds) for the trustee to deny a reclaim request
params.minCollateralIncrease: The minimum amount that can be deposited or reclaimed
params.trustee: H160 address of the trustee who has permissions to slash collateral or deny reclaim requests

denyReclaimRequest(uint256,string,bytes3.details: Can only be called by the trustee (address set in constructor)Must be called before the deny timeout expiresRemoves the reclaim request and frees up the collateral for other reclaimsEmits Denied event with the reclaim request IDReverts with NotTrustee if called by non-trustee addressReverts with ReclaimNotFound if the reclaim request doesn't existReverts with PastDenyTimeout if the timeout has already expired

params.reclaimRequestId: The ID of the reclaim request to deny
params.url: URL containing the reason of denial
params.urlContentSha256: SHA-256 checksum of the content at the provided URL

deposit(bytes32,bytes16).details: The first deposit for an nodeId sets the owner. Subsequent deposits must be from the owner.The deposited amount must be greater than or equal to MIN_COLLATERAL_INCREASEIf it's not revert with InsufficientAmount errorEmits a Deposit event with the hotkey, nodeId, sender's address and deposited amount

params.hotkey: The netuid key for the subnet
params.nodeId: The ID of the node to deposit collateral for

finalizeReclaim(uint256).details: Can be called by anyoneRequires that deny timeout has expiredIf the miner has been slashed and their collateral is insufficient for a reclaim, the reclaim is canceled but transactions completes successfully allowing to request another reclaimEmits Reclaimed event with reclaim details if successfulReverts with ReclaimNotFound if the reclaim request doesn't exist or was deniedReverts with BeforeDenyTimeout if the deny timeout hasn't expiredReverts with TransferFailed if the TAO transfer fails

params.reclaimRequestId: The ID of the reclaim request to finalize

reclaimCollateral(bytes32,bytes16,string.details: If it's not denied by the trustee, the collateral will be available for withdrawal after DECISION_TIMEOUTEmits ReclaimProcessStarted event with reclaim details and timeoutReverts with NodeNotOwned if caller is not the owner of the nodeReverts with AmountZero if there is no available collateral to reclaim

params.hotkey: The netuid key for the subnet
params.nodeId: The ID of the node to reclaim collateral from
params.url: URL containing information about the reclaim request
params.urlContentSha256: SHA-256 checksum of the content at the provided URL

slashCollateral(bytes32,bytes16,string,b.details: Can only be called by the trustee (address set in constructor)Removes the collateral from the node and burns itEmits Slashed event with the node's ID, miner's address and the amount slashedReverts with AmountZero if there is no collateral to slashReverts with TransferFailed if the TAO transfer fails

params.hotkey: The netuid key for the subnet
params.nodeId: The ID of the node to slash
params.url: URL containing the reason for slashing
params.urlContentSha256: SHA-256 checksum of the content at the provided URL

slashCollateralAmount(bytes32,bytes16,ui.details: Can only be called by the trustee (address set in constructor)Burns a specified amount of collateral for the nodeEmits Slashed event with the node's ID, miner's address and the amount slashedReverts with AmountZero if amount is zeroReverts with InsufficientAmount if amount exceeds collateralReverts with TransferFailed if the TAO transfer fails

params.hotkey: The netuid key for the subnet
params.nodeId: The ID of the node to slash
params.url: URL containing the reason for slashing
params.urlContentSha256: SHA-256 checksum of the content at the provided URL

constructor.notice: Initializes a new Collateral contract with specified parameters

denyReclaimRequest(uint256,string,bytes3.notice: Allows the trustee to deny a pending reclaim request before the timeout expires

deposit(bytes32,bytes16).notice: Allows users to deposit collateral into the contract for a specific node

finalizeReclaim(uint256).notice: Finalizes a reclaim request and transfers the collateral to the depositor if conditions are met

reclaimCollateral(bytes32,bytes16,string.notice: Initiates a process to reclaim all available collateral from a specific node

slashCollateral(bytes32,bytes16,string,b.notice: Allows the trustee to slash a miner's collateral for a specific node

slashCollateralAmount(bytes32,bytes16,ui.notice: Allows the trustee to partially slash a miner's collateral
